name: Kisdobsza (Hungary)
description: White field with a narrow green vertical stripe at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Kisdobsza (a red shield with a white bird and crossed tools) within a green wreath, above a yellow scroll inscribed KISDOBSZA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kisdobsza arms with wreath and scroll
